text:
maya: Quick sync — where are we on the pricing/packaging change dependencies? Need green on metering + billing + quota contracts before EOD Friday. Tagging owners: @kevin (metering), @anya (billing), @samir (contracts)

kevin: Metering: most work done. Adapter PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/312. Waiting on infra review for rate limit schema change. Blocker: schema migration needs quota team signoff. ETA tomorrow AM.

anya: Billing: billing side finished usage mapping. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/198. There's an edge-case for free-tier promos that affects token classification; filing ticket BILL-514 to track. Can be hotfixed if metering contract stays stable.

samir: Contracts: reviewing quota contract language. Need clarification: do dedicated customers get reserved quotas or just higher priority? If reserved, contracts need explicit phrasing re: overage billing. CC @zoe legal.

zoe: Legal: Preference is explicit reserved quota + overage rules. I'll push a redline by EOD. Need the final numbers from pricing to include in contract table.

maya: Pricing numbers are in sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcXYZ - range 'v2 numbers' last updated by me. Current proposal: reserved tier = 1.5x baseline, overage rate = $0.02/tokens. Need confirmation to finalize.

kevin: Small note: schema change includes field `reserved_quota_id`. If contracts won't include explicit IDs, we can use alias mapping, but that increases billing join complexity. If legal can accept alias pattern we can avoid a migration.

anya: Alias mapping acceptable from billing POV if it's stable. BILL-514 will note migration window. Can we plan a 2-week migration with fallback? @maya

maya: Yes, plan 2-week migration + canary for 48h. Ops: will need a meter-config rollout window. @eng-bot please create rollout ticket with canary steps.

eng-bot: Created ticket: INF-8842 - "metering rollout: pricing v2 canary" assigned to kevin, due in 2 days.

kevin: I'll pick up rollout steps tomorrow. Also flag: quota DB index change may need maintenance window (30m). Suggest scheduling during low-traffic.

zoe: Legal: I'll add alias acceptance clause and a rollback clause. Sending redline in doc.

samir: Once legal confirms, I can sign off contracts. Suggest we lock PR merges after legal sign-off to avoid drift.

maya: Sounds good. Owners: kevin (metering infra + rollout), anya (billing patch + promo fix), zoe (legal redline), samir (contract sign). I'll hold final merge until INF-8842 complete and legal OK. Thanks all :heart:

kevin: one more FYI — putting a small note in PR about `reserved_quota_id` format so infra-ops can reconcile later.

anya: ACK. I'll coordinate on BILL-514 for promo tests.

zoe: Added comments in doc and pinged sales for example customers to include in clauses.

maya: Great. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here and I'll escalate.
